Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Δ</mi></math> denote the area of the triangle formed by the tangent at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi></math>, the normal at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi></math> and the <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> -axis.
